{{Quote|I'd do any of those things if it would help defeat the Empire, but what I really want is to watch Imperial ships blow up in front of my gunsights. It's something I need to do.|Keyan Farlander|<ref name="tfp" />}}
'''Keyan Farlander''', nicknamed '''"Lucky"''', was an [[Agamarian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military. A native of the small town of [[Tondatha]], Farlander joined the [[Agamar Resistance]] after his hometown was [[Destruction of Tondatha|destroyed]] in an attack by forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], leaving his [[Keyan Farlander's mother|mother]] and [[Keyan Farlander's father|father]] [[Death/Legends|dead]] and [[Kitha Farlander|sister]] badly burned. After attending a recruitment rally by Rebel [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|leader]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], Farlander decided to join the fledgling Rebel Alliance and became a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]], serving in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].

Farlander participated in many of the early battles of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including the attack on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He would later survive the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Imperial attack]] on [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] and fight in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which saw the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

His skill as a pilot was aided by his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]] but, as he became aware of his potential, he struggled with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and found himself increasingly isolated. Farlander resolved to stop using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] until a meeting with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] helped him begin to understand his abilities. He later [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a Jedi at Skywalker's [[Jedi Praxeum]], combining his life in the [[New Jedi Order]] with his life as a military commander for the New Republic. By the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], he had been promoted to [[General/Legends|general]] and served as one of the Republic's senior commanders, leading their forces in several battles including the [[Battle of Ebaq]] and the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|Recapture of Coruscant]].

==Biography==
===Galactic Civil War===
====Recruitment====
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Keyan Farlander grew up in [[Tondatha]], a small town on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], an agricultural world<ref name="xw:osg" /> in the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|255|Farlander, Keyan}}</ref> He lived with his [[Keyan Farlander's mother|mother]], [[Keyan Farlander's father|father]] and sister, [[Kitha Farlander|Kitha]],<ref name="xw:osg" /> on his family's struggling [[mugruebe]] ranch.<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> He never had any objections to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule and, as a child, had watched landing vessels from a passing Imperial fleet pass over Tondatha and decided he wanted to join the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. This all changed however when the Empire, alleging that the residents of Tondatha had been plotting against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Destruction of Tondatha|destroyed]] the town with an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. At the time of the attack, Farlander was traveling through a [[binka]] forest in his [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]], on his way home from [[Calna Muun]] after running an errand for his father. Upon seeing the Imperial assault ship descending on Tondatha, he pushed the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] to its limits trying to get back home. By the time he reached Tondatha, the Imperial attack had begun. Farlander raced to his home to find his family but, shortly after entering, it was struck by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt and the roof collapsed around him. Although Farlander survived with only minor burns, his parents were [[Death/Legends|killed]], and his sister was badly burned.<ref name="xw:osg" />

[[File:RegistrationDroid-XW.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Protocol droid/Legends|registration protocol droid]] introduced Farlander to the ''Independence''.]]
Farlander sent his sister to live with their aunt [[Mimya]] and uncle [[Trinn]] on [[Oorn Tchis]], where she might receive treatment. Three months after the attack, Farlander moved to Calna Muun and, over the course of several months, began to seek out those who had reason to despise the Empire, eventually becoming involved in the [[Agamar Resistance]].<ref name="xw:osg" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' begins after the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'' establishes that the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] occurs at the end of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]{{'s}} second tour of duty. Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Events in ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'' before the end of the second tour of duty therefore take place in 1 BBY.</ref> just one month after joining the Resistance, Farlander attended a secret rally held by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to encourage the Agamar Resistance to become part of the Alliance.<ref name="tfp" />

Inspired by Mon Mothma's speech, Farlander decided to join the Rebellion as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="tfp" /> Soon after the rally was concluded, Farlander boarded the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the waiting [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] along with fellow [[Agamarian]] recruits [['Ndranth Poussan]], [[Sunnar Jan-lo]] and [[Breth Gart]], and several members of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew, including Mon Mothma's aide, [[Lynia Delline]]. Farlander had met Delline just after Mon Mothma's speech and the two chatted aboard the shuttle, with Delline suggesting that he could serve the Alliance in a less dangerous role. Farlander, however, was determined to become a pilot and Delline respected his decision. After arriving aboard the ''Independence'', Farlander was shown to his quarters and introduced to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hamo Blastwell]], who would serve as his liaison officer in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="xw:osg" />

Farlander's training began the following day. Under Blastwell's supervision, Farlander spent two days practicing in the [[The Maze (pilot proving ground)|pilot proving grounds]], an obstacle course designed to familiarize pilots with the basic functions of a starfighter. After passing his basic training, Farlander was sent to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wex Dafid|Wex "TIE-Die" Dafid]] for tactical combat training which comprised a series of [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulated]] recreations of historical combat scenarios. During his early training, Farlander met the legendary Rebel pilot [[Halley Kadorto]], who gave the younger pilot some combat advice.<ref name="xw:osg" />

====First mission====
{{Quote|Just keep your wits about you. You're a natural, you know.|Hamo Blastwell to Keyan Farlander|<ref name="1BBY" />}}
Farlander was still undergoing combat training, having just completed the final A-wing historical training mission<ref name="xw:osg" /> when he was picked for his [[Battle in the Turkana system|first mission]].<ref name="swxw">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> After only thirteen days of training, a shortage of pilots forced the Alliance to make use of the rookie in a mission to retrieve information stored on the Imperial [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Talon (Imperial corvette)|''Talon'']].<ref name="tfp" /> Farlander would fly a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] as part of Red Squadron, assisting the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Liberator (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Liberator'']] in engaging [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] escorts while [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] would disable ''Talon''. [[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]] would then board the ship and retrieve the information. The strike force would then retreat into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before Imperial reinforcements could arrive.<ref name="swxw" />

[[File:Farlander1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Keyan Farlander's X-wing approaches the ''Talon''.]]
Red Squadron emerged from hyperspace and began engaging TIE Fighter escorts. However, a call from Storm Unit needing an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] caused Farlander to break off and dock with ''Talon''. While Storm Unit fought against defending [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Farlander and [[R2 (Keyan Farlander)|his R2 unit]] worked their way to the bridge where they deactivated any remaining [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries and began downloading data from the ship's computer. He also relieved the Imperial [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of some disks which he was attempting to destroy, killing the officer in the process, before returning to ''Independence''.<ref name="tfp" />

The information recovered included a copy of the top secret Imperial document, ''[[Technical Specifications: Spacecraft of the Imperium and the Rebel Alliance]]'', detailing specifications of both Imperial and Rebel spacecraft and providing the Rebels with insight into the enemy's strengths and weaknesses. Farlander's actions earned him a promotion to lieutenant, and the nickname Lucky.<ref name="tfp" /> The mission was later entered into the historical missions database for training of new pilots<ref name="swxw" /> and Rebel [[Historian/Legends|historians]] documented Farlander's actions in a file intended to inspire new recruits.<ref name="tfp" /> Impressed by Farlander's performance in his first mission and his near perfect scores in the simulators, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] requested that he enter active duty as soon as possible.<ref name="xw:osg" />

====Operation Strike Fear====
{{Quote|Just remember everything you've learned here, and don't take this hero business too seriously. Heroes who fly starfighters most often meet with a quick end.|Wex Dafid to Keyan Farlander|<ref name="1BBY" />}}
Farlander was instrumental in the Rebellion's actions over the coming months. The day after completing his last combat simulation, Farlander was officially assigned to Red Squadron and attended a briefing on the Alliance's plan to defeat a massive Imperial offensive known as [[Operation Strike Fear]]. An opportunity to learn more about the Empire's plans soon arose when the crew of the Imperial CR90 corvette ''[[Bixby]]'' announced their intention to defect to the Alliance. Farlander was assigned as Blastwell's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] on a mission to [[Battle in the Dellalt system|destroy]] a convoy under escort from the ''Bixby'', while the corvette was secured for the Alliance. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nogdra]] of the ''Bixby'' brought intelligence of an Imperial staging point near [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] and Farlander was selected to conduct a [[Mission in the Dellalt system|reconnaissance flight]] in a lone [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]], confirming the presence of a large Imperial force led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']].<ref name="xw:osg" />

[[File:Farlander_Shooting.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Keyan Farlander shoots the commander of the ''Talon''.]]
Several days after his solo mission, Farlander attended a briefing by General Dodonna. The general had already been planning to evacuate the [[Brigia Rebel base|Rebel base]] on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], but recent intelligence indicated that the base was to be the first target of Operation Strike Fear, forcing the Alliance to act sooner than planned. Farlander was assigned to provide cover for the senior staff shuttles during the evacuation, his [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] arriving in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] shortly before the ''Invincible''. Though Rebel losses in the subsequent [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] were heavy, Farlander helped ensure that all senior staff shuttles escaped to hyperspace. He had little time to relax, however&mdash;shortly after returning to the ''Independence'', Farlander was sent to defend the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], which was receiving wounded from the battle. When the ''Redemption'' came under [[Skirmish near Brigia|attack]] from the Imperial Nebulon-B frigate [[Warspite (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Warspite'']], Farlander helped cover the transfer of wounded until all ships were safely away.<ref name="xw:osg" /> This mission too was recreated as a [[Redemption scenario|training scenario]] and later used by the elite [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="xw:rs">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>

The following day, Farlander participated in a [[Raid on the Juno convoy|raid]] on an Imperial convoy, aimed at disrupting the Empire's resupply efforts ahead of planned attack on [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]]. He was joined on the raid by fellow Agamarian Sunnar Jan-lo, who would become a close friend within Red Squadron.<ref name="xw:osg" /> Around this time, [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply Command]] reported a major shortage of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] for use with the X-wing and Y-wing starfighters. When an A-wing flight reported that the Imperial [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Ars Opus]]'' had broken down near Rudrig with a shipment of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]],<ref name="swxw" /> Farlander helped provide cover for a [[Raid in the Rudrig system|recovery operation]]. Shortly after the mission, however, the Rebels learned that the stolen droids had been tampered with&mdash;the R2 units hijacked three X-wings, including one flown by Blastwell, and were attempting to deliver them to the ''Invincible''. The Rebels promptly dispatched the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser ''[[Maximus]]'' to [[Mission to recover stolen X-wings|retrieve]] the X-wings, while Farlander helped provide cover.<ref name="xw:osg" />

[[File:FarlanderMedal.png|thumb|right|200px|Farlander attends an award ceremony.]]
Shortly after rescuing his friend, Farlander and Blastwell were called to a private briefing with Commander [[H. S'man]], who informed them of a plan to [[Rescue of Sullustan Tech Staff|rescue]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] prisoners being transferred from their [[Sullust/Legends|homeworld]] to the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] planned a low-key raid to rescue the prisoners, hoping to gain the support of the Sullustans against the Empire. Due to Farlander's ability to assess a situation and react under pressure, he was selected to fly a lone Y-wing in the mission.<ref name="xw:osg" /> The rescue was a success and negotiations between [[Sullustan Resistance|Sullustan rebels]] and the Alliance soon began.<ref name="swxw" /> Both Farlander and Blastwell were assigned to fly patrol for a summit meeting between the two resistance groups. When the ''Invincible'' [[Diplomatic Summit at Sullust|attacked]] the meeting, Farlander helped to fend off Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]] until the diplomatic ships escaped. However, they soon learned that the Imperial attack had been a diversion while the Empire kidnapped the Sullustan leader and Farlander was again called into action during the subsequent [[Rescue of Sian Tevv|rescue]].<ref name="xw:osg" />

Farlander was promoted to captain upon his return to the ''Independence''. Following his debriefing, he celebrated his promotion with several of his friends aboard the ship, including Blastwell, Jan-lo and Lynia Delline, recently returned to the ship following an extended trip with Mon Mothma. He soon began to develop a romantic interest in Delline, although she was frequently off-ship and the two found it hard to find time together.<ref name="xw:osg" />

Soon after Farlander's promotion, Sullustan technicians worked with General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] to devise a plan to put an end to Operation Strike Fear by [[Destruction of the Invincible|destroying]] the ''Invincible''. The first part of the plan involved [[Capture of Cygnus Staff|capturing]] some of the design staff from [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]], who would be needed to help modify a shuttle for the operation. Intelligence reports led the Rebels to a Cygnus test facility where the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] was undergoing trials<ref name="swxw" /> and Farlander and Jan-lo were dispatched to provide cover for the capture operation. Farlander was also involved in the next stage of the operation, the capture of an Imperial explosive device en route to [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]].<ref name="xw:osg" /> The captured explosive was loaded aboard a modified shuttle and delivered to the ''Invincible''. The Imperial command ship was destroyed by the subsequent explosion, putting an end to Operation Strike Fear. Farlander was later presented with the [[Corellian Cross/Legends|Corellian Cross]] for his role in ending the operation.<ref name="swxw" />

====Search for the Death Star====
{{Quote|It's the war. You can't stay young for long. The young die young.|Keyan Farlander|<ref name="1BBY" />}}
[[File:Genue.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Farlander's A-wing during the rescue from Stars' End.]]
Shortly after the end of Operation Strike Fear, the Alliance began to hear rumors that the Empire was developing a new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and began to search for information regarding the nature of the threat.<ref name="xw:osg" /> Early in the search, a group of captured Rebel pilots escaped from [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] aboard a freighter bound for [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="swxw" /> Farlander flew an A-wing during a mission to [[Rescue from Stars' End|rescue]] the pilots, in which he was accompanied by Lieutenant [[Cardacs]], a new transfer to Red Squadron and a friend of one of the captured pilots, Captain [[Samuel Raider]]. Though the rescue was a success, Cardacs was killed during the mission and Raider held Farlander responsible, angrily confronting him the following day. However, after the two worked together on a [[Rescue of enslaved Wookiees|mission]] to rescue [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] being transferred to a major Imperial construction project, Raider apologized to Farlander and the two began to develop a friendship.<ref name="xw:osg" />

During his next mission, an [[Battle of Orron III|attack]] on an Imperial weapons convoy near [[Orron III]], Farlander made a mistake by calling on his wingmen, [[Tan'tro]] and [[Ahsmar]], to assist him in destroying a freighter, causing them to turn tail on attacking assault gunboats. Both pilots were killed and Farlander's briefing officer, Commander [[Lagrane]], suspended him from operations pending an official inquest regarding the incident. Farlander had the support of his wingmates, including Blastwell and Raider, during his suspension, and was eventually returned to active duty with a warning and a compulsory visit to the flight simulators for some brushing up.<ref name="xw:osg" />

His next two missions were flown without wingmen;<ref name="xw:osg" /> a raid to [[Ambush of the Phoenix|capture]] a freighter carrying Imperial [[communications satellite]]s, followed by covering a [[Attack on the Phoenix|rendezvous]] between the captured freighter [[Phoenix (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Phoenix'']] and the cruiser ''Maximus''.<ref name="swxw" /> Around this time, Mon Mothma visited the ''Independence''&mdash;Farlander was excited to see Delline with her and the two dined together in the ship's executive dining room before Delline's duties once more took her off the ship. The captured satellites were to be used to eavesdrop on Imperial transmissions in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]. However, when the freighter ''[[Ojai]]'' came under [[Ambush in the Cron Drift|attack]] while transferring the satellites to the corvette ''[[Jeffrey]]'', Farlander was once more called into action to defend the rendezvous.<ref name="xw:osg" />

The captured satellites were deployed by the ''Jeffrey'' and soon picked up an Imperial signal containing [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for their new weapon&mdash;the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="swxw" /> The plans were to be transferred to the ''Liberty'' by Rebel pilot [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]. However, when his X-wing broke down and came under attack from Imperial forces, Farlander led an A-wing flight to protect the [[Rescue of Biggs Darklighter|recovery]] of the X-wing and the data it contained. Darklighter later joined Farlander and Raider in the pilots' lounge, and the three shared their experiences.<ref name="xw:osg" />

[[File:Intrepid.jpg|thumb|right|Farlander participates in the attack on the ''Intrepid''.]]
Soon after, the Alliance learned that the Star Destroyer [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']] had been damaged and was awaiting repairs. They soon launched a [[Battle of the Circarpous system (Galactic Civil War)|series of operations]] aimed at the destruction of the Star Destroyer.<ref name="swxw" /> Farlander participated in the first of these raids, destroying a freighter carrying a replacement [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. However, the pressure of battle combined with losing so many friends was starting to have an effect on him. Also, although he was not yet aware of it, Farlander was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], which started to manifest itself in his dreams and was affecting his concentration. Following the ''Intrepid'' mission, Farlander informed Commander Lagrane about his dreams and was told to consult the ship's medical crew. Although a [[M4|medical droid]] was concerned about Farlander's condition, the pilot unknowingly used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|persuade]] a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] to let him remain on duty with a course of sedatives to aid his sleep.<ref name="xw:osg" />

Farlander returned from the medical bay just in time to get his next assignment, an assault on the ''Intrepid''{{'s}} escort ships which would leave it virtually defenseless. Less than an hour after returning to the ''Independence'', he took part in the final assault on the ''Intrepid'', a combined X-wing, Y-wing and A-wing attack. Farlander and Jan-lo quickly brought down the Star Destroyer's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] with their X-wings, allowing the Y-wings' [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] barrage to eliminate the vessel,<ref name="xw:osg" /> the first time the Rebels destroyed a Star Destroyer in a frontal attack.<ref name="swxw" /> After returning to the ''Independence'', Farlander visited Jan-lo, who had been injured in the battle, as she received [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatment.<ref name="xw:osg" />

Though the destruction of the ''Intrepid'' was a huge victory for the Alliance, they had little time to celebrate.<ref name="xw:osg" /> The Death Star plans were to be transported to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by his adopted daughter, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Just a few days after the ''Intrepid'' mission, Farlander flew protection for the [[Death Star plans delivery|transfer]] of the plans to Organa's ship, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], and was called on again when the ship came under [[Assault on the Tantive IV|attack]] from the Star Destroyer ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]''. Despite his efforts, Farlander soon learned that the ''Tantive IV'' had once more come under attack and the fate of both Organa and the Death Star plans was unknown. Nonetheless, he was presented with the [[Mantooine Medallion/Legends|Mantooine Medallion]] for his role in capturing the plans and delivering them to Organa.<ref name="swxw" />

====The gathering storm====
{{Quote|The Force is the ultimate power. With it, you can destroy your enemies. Just open yourself to it, let it guide you, and you'll be unbeatable.|Keyan Farlander|<ref name="1BBY" />}}
Shortly after Organa's disappearance<ref name="xw:osg" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> High Command organized a briefing during which General Dodonna outlined their plan to delay the completion of the Death Star and Farlander was awarded a medal for one of his recent missions. Immediately after the briefing, Farlander was back in action with a [[Capture of the Sidral II|mission]] to guard a weapons transfer between the recently captured freighter ''[[Sidral II]]'' and the corvette ''[[Frazier]]''.<ref name="xw:osg" /> Part of the shipment of military hardware aboard the ''Sidral II'' had passed through an Imperial repair yard near Coruscant and the Alliance believed that an attack on the facility would cripple the infrastructure that serviced ships involved in the Death Star project.<ref name="swxw" /> Farlander flew a Y-wing in a [[Attack on the Imperial repair dock|raid]] which eliminated the facility and saw combat again while overseeing the [[Capture of the Omicron 1|capture]] of a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] carrying military advisors working on the Death Star,<ref name="xw:osg" /> after it was sabotaged by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="swxw" />

Around this time, Farlander became a liaison to Breth Gart, a young Agamarian who joined the Alliance at the same time as Farlander but had only recently been accepted as a pilot. Due to their shared Agamarian background, the two pilots quickly became friends and Farlander took Gart with him on a temporary assignment to the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']], during which the pair [[Attack on the Defiance|defended]] it from the Star Destroyer ''Immortal''. After returning to the ''Independence'', Farlander was approached by Blastwell, recently promoted to commander, about a [[Capture of the Death Star design team|mission]] to capture members of the Death Star design team. While [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] engaged its defenses, Farlander's Y-wing disabled the corvette ''[[Godar]]'' as it headed for a rendezvous with the ''Immortal'', allowing the designers to be captured by a Rebel [[Rescue 1 (Lambda-class)|shuttle]].<ref name="xw:osg" />

Gart was later killed flying with Farlander in a freak collision with the Imperial frigate [[Priam (starship)|''Priam'']] during an [[Battle of Kalla VII|attack]] on the Imperial base at [[Kalla VII]]. Farlander found it difficult to cope with Gart's death, and his failure to turn up for his mission debriefing led Commander Lagrane to recommend him for a psychological evaluation. That night, Farlander's dreams returned and he heard voices telling him that Gart was weak and that only power would defeat the Empire and end the war. His superiors, concerned about his mental state, planned to ground him until Farlander used the Force to persuade them to let him stay active. Returning to combat, Farlander participated in two raids against the ''Priam'', the first to destroy its escort, and the second to assist in the capture of the frigate itself.<ref name="xw:osg" />

[[File:Farlander2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Keyan Farlander's X-wing is destroyed.]]
Farlander's first experiences with the Force were untrained, and he was influenced by spirits from both the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] and [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] sides of the Force, leading him dangerously close to the dark side before he finally discovered that the Force was more than just a source of power. He discovered that he could touch the minds of enemy pilots, almost being able to steer them right into his sights. Hoping to produce an unstoppable squadron of pilots guided by the Force, he took on a group of young pilots to instruct, promoting aggression and a sense of invulnerability in them. Although the rookie pilots looked up to him and believed what he had to say, his unusual behavior started to alienate the more experienced pilots.<ref name="xw:osg" />

Farlander was assigned to cover the [[Skirmish in the Horuz system|recapture]] of the Corellian corvettes [[Ethar]] I and II.<ref name="swxw" /> He decided to show that he was right by taking two of his followers, [[Casal Marskan]] and [[Horodi]], with him. Although the mission was successful, both of his wingmen were killed and, for the first time in his career, Farlander's ship was destroyed, though he safely [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejected]].<ref name="xw:osg" />

Back on the ''Independence'', Farlander was confronted by Casal's older brother, Captain [[Ernek Marskan]] of Blue Squadron, who blamed him for his brother's death. Farlander used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|choke]] Marskan but released him before it was too late. Farlander was appalled by the thought that he almost killed Marskan but was convinced that his wingmen had been unworthy of the Force and others would have more success. He found several more young pilots willing to listen, though he was no longer considered welcome by those he had previously called friends, including Marskan, Raider and [[Speedy]].<ref name="xw:osg" />

When he was confronted by Blastwell, upon returning from guard duty at a Rebel supply depot, Farlander felt suddenly disoriented and lost consciousness, hearing a voice warning him to turn away from the dark side before he was consumed by it. When he awoke moments later, Farlander declined Blastwell's offer to take him to a doctor, instead choosing to return to his cabin so he could try and work out what was happening to him. He was still in his quarters several hours later when the ''Independence'' came under attack from the ''Immortal'' while on its way to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Farlander scrambled to his X-wing and helped defend the ship. During the [[Attack on the Independence|battle]], Farlander once more felt the call of the dark side, at one point causing him to lower his shields, rendering him momentarily helpless. However, the light side spirits won out, and he turned his back on the other, darker voices, regaining control of his fighter. Neither voice returned after the battle and Farlander decided not to use the Force again until he better understood it.<ref name="xw:osg" />

====The Battle of Yavin====
{{Quote|This was a do-or-die mission. We all knew it. For most of us, it was die.|Keyan Farlander on the Battle of Yavin|<ref name="xw:osg" />}}
[[File:FarlanderYavin-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Farlander's Y-wing escapes the Death Star moments before its destruction.]]
Shortly after arriving at Yavin 4, Farlander was one of several pilots transferred to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] to help in the upcoming [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]] against the Death Star. It was there that he met [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The two began talking and Farlander introduced him to the basics of flying an X-wing. Skywalker passed on some of what [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had taught him about the Force, and, though Farlander still did not feel ready to use it, he was relieved to meet somebody who understood what he was going through and hoped one day to master the Force and become a Jedi.<ref name="xw:osg" />

While the Rebels waited for the Death Star to arrive, they planned some actions against its support fleet. Farlander flew some preliminary missions to disrupt communications and defenses around the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]].<ref name="swxw" /> For the main attack on the Death Star, Farlander was temporarily reassigned to Gold Squadron and flew a Y-wing in the battle,<ref name="xw:osg" /> under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Gold Seven/Legends|Gold Seven]]. His role was to provide tactical support<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref> and to hold off enemy fighters while others made a trench run.<ref name="xw:osg" />

Despite heavy Rebel losses, the Battle of Yavin was a victory, with Skywalker firing the shots that destroyed the battlestation. Farlander was one of the few pilots to survive the attack<ref name="xw:osg" />&mdash;and the only member of Gold Squadron<ref name="Blueprints" />&mdash;and was promoted to commander after the battle before attending a medal ceremony for Skywalker, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Farlander was unable to enjoy the victory as much as many at Yavin Base, however&mdash;Hamo Blastwell, his closest friend and the only pilot who had stood by him recently, had apparently been killed during the battle and he still faced a tough fight to redeem himself in the eyes of the other pilots. One of his friends did continue to keep faith in him and Lynia Delline promised to spend more time with him in the coming months.<ref name="xw:osg" />

====Imperial pursuit====
Despite the destruction of the Death Star, the Alliance did not have long to celebrate&mdash;the location of Yavin Base was compromised and they were forced to evacuate. Farlander provided cover for the evacuation of corvette group [[Crescent (corvette group)|''Crescent'']] as they made their jump to hyperspace, using his A-wing to hold off starfighters from the frigate ''[[Red Wind]]'', and was soon dispatched again to guard a transit point for more fleeing Rebel ships, helping to save many Alliance personnel. He would encounter the ''Red Wind'' again during a later mission to escort a convoy carrying equipment for a new Rebel base while the Alliance searched for a suitable location. The Alliance eventually planned a retaliatory [[Attack on the Red Wind|strike]] against the frigate, in which Farlander participated.<ref name="ip">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref>

The Rebels suffered a major loss when the ''Maximus''{{'s}} [[Task force/Legends|task force]] came under attack, forcing the evacuation of the cruiser. Farlander led a pair of X-wings sent to assist the cruiser's A-wings while they covered the evacuation, and helped ensure the survival of the ship's crew. He later joined Rebel fighters in defending the frigate [[Anvil (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Anvil'']] as it was resupplied by the corvette ''[[Lauhu]]''. Though the ''Anvil'' survived an assault from Imperial frigate ''[[Firelance]]'', it was heavily damaged and the crew were forced to abandon ship soon after. Farlander was once more called upon to aid in the evacuation.<ref name="ip" />

Despite Farlander's efforts during the evacuation of Yavin, the Alliance lost several ships carrying food supplies, leaving them with critically low stocks. It was vital that the Rebels protect their remaining supplies, so Farlander was sent to guard the damaged [[Grain/Legends|grain]] freighter ''[[Op Mus]]'', while the transport ''[[Jaamn]]'' conducted repairs. In a subsequent mission, Farlander guarded the freighter ''[[Trips]]'' while it recovered a [[Class-A cargo container|container]] of grain which had been dropped by a Rebel ship in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]] while evading an Imperial attack. Having secured their remaining supplies, the Rebels began searching for new sources and dispatched Farlander in a Y-wing to identify and disable an Imperial convoy ship carrying food for capture by the transport [[Raider (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|''Raider'']].<ref name="ip" />

[[File:FarlanderUniform.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Keyan Farlander's uniform just after the Battle of Yavin.]]
A solution to the food shortage soon appeared possible when Imperial [[Overlord (Imperial)|Overlord]] [[Ghorin]] of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]] claimed to have grown sympathetic to the Rebellion and entered negotiations to supply them with grain. An initial shipment was arranged and Farlander was sent to clear a [[Space mine/Legends|mine field]] in the area ahead of the delivery, and to conduct a diversionary raid on a listening station near [[Saheelindeel]] to draw away Imperial forces. He later provided cover for the transfer of the grain. However, tests on the delivery showed that Ghorin had betrayed the Alliance by supplying them with [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] grain and, seeking an alternate source, Farlander was sent to assist in a raid on an Imperial storage facility. With a grain supply secured, Alliance High Command developed a plan to get revenge on Ghorin. Farlander was instrumental in the [[Operation Grain Snatch|operation]], helping to capture some of Ghorin's Y-wings, and using them in raids on a supply storage area in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan D1 sector]] and an Imperial [[Geedon|convoy]] en route to the [[Geedon system/Legends|Geedon system]]. Finally, Farlander helped assault a convoy delivering grain from Ghorin to an Imperial base. Swapping the grain aboard the convoy craft for the tainted grain acquired from Ghorin, the Rebels made it appear that the overlord had betrayed the Empire. Farlander later confirmed the success of the plan with a reconnaissance flight to check that a poisoned grain delivery arrived at the frigate [[Elite (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Elite'']]. The tainted grain delivery convinced the Emperor that Ghorin was a traitor and he was soon executed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ip" />

When [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] learned that the Empire was testing the new [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] at a secret base, Farlander led a raid on the facility, destroying the static defenses and enabling the freighter ''[[Ashanti]]'' to capture one of the fighters. After a later mission to defend a [[Leafar]] convoy as it came under attack from Imperial forces, the Leafar provided information that the TIE Avenger's [[Shield X|new shield technology]] was being adapted for larger vessels, with a Corellian corvette reportedly next to receive the technology. The Rebels planned to capture the test ship by using assault gunboats to sneak into the area and Farlander participated in a raid to capture three of the starfighters. In a subsequent mission, the captured gunboats escorted Farlander's Y-wing into the Imperial test facility, claiming that he was a defecting Rebel pilot. Farlander located and disabled the prototype, the corvette [[Ram's Head|''Blade 5'']], then helped protect Storm Unit as they captured the ship. In his next mission, he helped guard the ''Blade 5'', now renamed the ''Ram's Head'', as it rendezvoused with the corvette ''Libra'' ahead of a major operation codenamed [[Operation Ram's Head]]. The ''Ram's Head'' was later used to ram the bridges of several Star Destroyers at [[Imperial Drydock IV]]. His efforts during the period between the evacuation of Yavin to the protection of the ''Ram's Head'' earned Farlander the [[Shield of Yavin]].<ref name="ip" />

====Battles of the Galactic Civil War====
[[File:KeyanFarlander.png|200px|thumb|Keyan Farlander during the Galactic Civil War]]
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, and his recruitment into the Rebel Alliance, Farlander partook in a skirmish against at least one [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]]. Farlander was defeated in the fight, but managed to escape alive in his crippled T-65 X-wing starfighter. Farlander also participated in battles between Rebel and Imperial forces in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo]], [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo]], [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian]], [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine]], and [[Karthakk system]]s during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These battles involved an Imperial [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] being pitted against a Rebel Nebulon-B escort frigate, with numerous starfighters aiding in the defense or offense of the system.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

====The B-wing project====
{{Quote|Lieutenant Farlander, do you have the B-wings combat-ready?''"<br />"''Yes Commander Skywalker, they will be a powerful new weapon against the Empire.''"<br />"''Good work, Lieutenant.|Luke Skywalker and Keyan Farlander|audio=Farlander.flac|<ref name="swxw" />}}
After a short leave following the ''Ram's Head'' operation, Farlander returned to duty to assist in the final stages of the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] project,<ref name="bw">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]''</ref> a new [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] designed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] with the aid of [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]], a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] starfighter manufacturer operating in the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Working with other pilots from Red and Gold Squadrons, Farlander provided cover for a makeshift assembly area for the new starfighter. After defeating an initial Imperial raid on the facility, the Rebels were forced to evacuate. The attack was witnessed by a [[Habassa]]n ship and the Habassa agreed to help with the evacuation by sending the corvette ''[[Habatok 2]]'' to assist. Farlander was sent as part of a four ship group of X-wings to cover the evacuation, fending off an attack by the Star Destroyer [[Relentless (Sunaj IV)|''Relentless'']] until assembly area's crew, and all B-wings, escaped to hyperspace. The Rebels soon began to deploy the new B-wings to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], and Farlander worked with Luke Skywalker to get the new fighters operational, starting by replacing the aging Y-wings of Blue Squadron aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Maria (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Maria'']], and later helping to ensure their safe delivery to the cruiser ''[[Cathleen]]''.<ref name="bw" />

[[File:FarlanderSkywalker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Keyan Farlander and Luke Skywalker discuss the B-wing project.]]
Following simulator training on the B-wing, Farlander got to use the new bomber in combat for the first time in an [[attack on a TIE staging area]] near [[Yunkor IX]]. He was later one of four handpicked pilots for a mission to destroy an Imperial weapons research facility that was attempting to recreate the ''Ram's Head''{{'s}} shield technology. Since the base was lightly defended, the Rebels decided to test the tactical effectiveness of their four main starfighters. Farlander flew a B-wing in the mission, pairing with an A-wing, while a second pair consisted of an X-wing and a Y-wing.<ref name="bw" />

The Habassa had had little contact with the Empire and were initially skeptical to Rebel claims. Nevertheless, the Alliance hoped to convince them to join the Rebellion. When Alliance Intelligence learned that a number of Habassan prisoners were being transported by the Empire for use as slave laborers, the Rebels realized that this was their chance to make the Habassan leaders see the threat posed by the Empire and planned a rescue. Farlander participated in a raid on the Imperial convoy transporting the prisoners as it awaited the frigate ''[[Mayhem]]'' near [[Cificap VIII]] and later took part in a mission to rescue a Habassan convoy from Imperial attack. The Alliance's intervention convinced the Habassan leaders to join the Alliance and a formal declaration was arranged aboard the ''Independence''. The Habassa were impressed by Red Squadron's performance in previous operations and requested that the squadron provide cover for the meeting. Farlander was one of the pilots selected and flew an A-wing to rendezvous with the Habassan transport ''[[Bardictol]]'', escorting it to the ''Independence'' before helping to defeat an Imperial attack by the frigates ''[[Riptide]]'' and ''[[Havok]]''. After joining the Alliance, the Habassa made a delivery of foodstuffs to Rebel forces and Farlander helped to oversee the transfer. Later, when a Habassan convoy came under attack in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]], Farlander was once again sent to assist, his group of four B-wings saving the convoy from a superior number of assault gunboats.<ref name="bw" />

The Alliance soon discovered that the ''Relentless'' was coordinating the Empire's efforts to locate the Alliance Fleet. To aid in its efforts, the Empire was distributing probes throughout the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] out of a cargo transfer area near [[Bofa II]]. The Rebels devised a plan to disguise their movements by capturing Imperial probes and modifying them to submit false reports. Farlander participated in the operation, flying a B-wing to escort Storm Unit during the capture of the probe-carrying freighter ''[[Libom]]''. In order for the modified probes to be effective, the Rebels also had to neutralize the squadrons of corvettes and assault gunboats conducting patrols of nearby systems. To this end, Farlander flew one of three B-wings involved in assaults on recon bases in the [[Farfeld system/Legends|Farfeld]] and [[Feenicks system/Legends|Feenicks systems]]. Despite several skirmishes with the ''Relentless''{{'s}} task force, the Alliance was still uncertain of its size and composition. In order to ascertain this, Farlander participated in a raid on the Imperial frigate ''Mayhem'' designed to capture personnel with knowledge of the Imperial forces. Interrogation of the captured officers revealed that Rebel attacks had reduced the task force's frigates to a single ship&mdash;the ''[[Juvaini]]''. Farlander's A-wing provided escort for Blue Squadron's B-wings as they led an assault that destroyed the frigate.<ref name="bw" />

[[File:Farlander-RotJ.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Farlander attends a briefing before the Battle of Endor.]]
The Habassa provided the Rebels with data on a number of planets and moons suitable for building a new main base. However, before establishing a base, the Rebels needed to shake off their Imperial pursuers. They therefore launched a series of operations designed to culminate in the destruction of the ''Relentless''. The first stage was to eliminate a new series of probes undergoing calibration tests. Farlander then participated in an attack on a convoy delivering replacement starfighters to the ''Relentless'', leaving the ship as vulnerable as possible. Finally, Farlander flew a B-wing in an assault on the ''Relentless'' itself. Entering the area first, Farlander and his wingmate were charged with eliminating the Star Destroyer's shield generators prior to the arrival of Blue Squadron's main assault force. The mission was a success, severely reducing the Empire's ability to track Rebel movements.<ref name="bw" />

The Habassan information led the Rebels to establish [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the remote ice world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. In order to ensure a safe flight to the new base, the Rebels conducted [[Operation Blunt Stick|simultaneous attacks]] on all remaining Imperial probes in the sector. Farlander flew a lone B-wing against one such probe. Although most of the Alliance Fleet was able to make the journey to Hoth without incident, Farlander was again called into action to rescue the cruisers ''Cathleen'', ''[[Yali]]'' and ''Maria'' from Imperial attack, helping to destroy an Imperial strike force consisting of several frigates in the process. For his efforts, Farlander was awarded with the [[Talons of Hoth]].<ref name="bw" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[Death Squadron/Legends|Imperial forces]] under the command of Darth Vader located the Rebel base on Hoth. The Imperials launched a [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|major assault]]<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> but Farlander's Force-sensitivity helped him to survive the subsequent evacuation.<ref name="wwnjo" />

====The Battle of Endor====
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Alliance learned that the Empire was constructing a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] in orbit of the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] and that Emperor Palpatine would be personally overseeing the final stages of construction.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Farlander attended a briefing aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']],<ref name="Insider125">{{InsiderCite|125|Ask Lobot}}</ref> during which Mon Mothma, Admiral Ackbar and General Madine outlined a plan to [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] the battlestation before it became operational.<ref name="RotJ" /> Farlander flew a B-wing under the call sign [[Blue Nine/Legends|Blue Nine]]<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75010|name=B-wing Starfighter & Planet Endor}} {{Ret}}</ref><ref name="FBTB" /> during the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Insider125" /> engaging enemy fighters<ref name="Hasbro" /> while [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] destroyed the battlestation.<ref name="RotJ" />

===New Jedi Order===
{{Quote|I hope that we may once more operate together against our common enemy. I will cooperate with you to the utmost of my power, and if the Hapes Cluster is again attacked, I hope you will feel free to call for my assistance. But I can't speak for my superiors, and I may be superseded at any time.|General Farlander to Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo|<ref name="dw" />}}
[[File:FarlanderHangar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Farlander boards an X-wing.]]
After the death of the Emperor at Endor,<ref name="RotJ" /> the Rebel Alliance established a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and reclaimed much of the territory formerly held by the Empire.<ref name="NEC" /> Luke Skywalker became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and established a [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="wwnjo" /> Recognizing Farlander's skills, Skywalker tested his Force potential. The results of the test were positive<ref name="CSWE" /> and, despite his previous poor experience with the Force,<ref name="xw:osg" /> Farlander accepted Skywalker's invitation to return to Yavin 4 to undergo training at the [[Jedi Praxeum]]. After years of training, he became a Jedi Knight himself,<ref name="CSWE" /> and continued to assist Skywalker in training others, often working as a Jedi piloting instructor.<ref name="wwnjo" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the extra-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] began an [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the New Republic. The war soon turned against the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong won a string of victories, culminating in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|capture]] of the New Republic capital world of Coruscant in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Farlander served in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] during the war and was stationed aboard the [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]] ''[[Ralroost]]'', the flagship of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Admiral [[Traest Kre'fey]], following the fall of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE" />

====Second Battle of Obroa-skai====
{{Quote|One capital ship lost, another disabled. Nearly a hundred starfighters lost, with only forty percent of the crews rescued&mdash;all in an unauthorized action to chase an enemy Supreme Commander who wasn't even there, and following an operational plan devised by a junior lieutenant.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.''"<br />"''And a stunning victory. Seven enemy capital ships destroyed, a pair of transports holding thousands of warriors, and a Supreme Commander killed along with his flagship. My warmest congratulations to the both of you. I wish my other subordinates demonstrated this kind of initiative.|Traest Kre'fey and Keyan Farlander, on the victory at Obroa-skai|<ref name="dw" />}}
By early [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Farlander held the rank of general and was in command of the [[MC80B Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mon Adapyne]]'', under the immediate command of Kre'fey. Following the death of New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] during the fall of Coruscant, Admiral Kre'fey was recalled to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] for the official period of mourning, leaving Farlander to act without instructions from his superiors. When Farlander learned through [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] that the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Yuuzhan Vong [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]] would be passing through the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa system]], the general decided to enact a [[Second Battle of Obroa-skai|plan]] devised by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] in the hopes of destroying Shimrra's ship and ending the war.<ref name="dw" />

Farlander commanded a task force of two MC80B Star Cruisers, four [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunships]], three [[Republic-class cruiser|''Republic''-class cruisers]], a ''Lancer''-class frigate and several squadrons of starfighters, waiting just four light-hours away from [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] for a signal from [[Major/Legends|Major]] Solo, commanding the captured Yuuzhan Vong [[Ro'ik chuun m'arh|frigate]] ''[[Trickster]]'' to inform them that Shimrra's fleet had arrived. A [[Hapan]] fleet under [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] were to wait to enter the battle until either victory was assured or reinforcements were needed to cover a retreat.<ref name="dw" />

The ''Trickster'' entered the Obroa system first, masquerading as a damaged Yuuzhan Vong vessel. Upon receiving the signal from Solo, Farlander's fleet made the short jump to Obroa-skai, emerging behind the ''Trickster'' as if in pursuit of the ship. The Yuuzhan Vong vessels moved to engage the newcomers and to protect their damaged ship, allowing Solo to maneuver close to the enemy flagship. Key to the battle plan were the [[Gravitic amplitude modulator|yammosk jammers]] that could interfere with the [[yammosk]]s used by the Yuuzhan Vong to coordinate their forces. With the jammer deployed, Farlander attempted to take his forces through the enemy lines, but the Yuuzhan Vong countered his maneuvers. Just as it appeared that the jammer had been unsuccessful, Solo realized that the enemy were using two yammosks, one aboard the flagship and one on Obroa-skai. Quickly deploying a second jammer, the New Republic forces began to take control of the battle while the ''Trickster'' finished moving into position. On Farlander's command, Solo opened fire on the Yuuzhan Vong flagship. As the defenders turned back to attack the ''Trickster'', Farlander called in the Hapan fleet. Caught between the New Republic and Hapan forces, the remaining Yuuzhan Vong forces were quickly destroyed.<ref name="dw" />

Only after the conclusion of the battle did Farlander learn from New Republic Intelligence that the Yuuzhan Vong fleet had, in fact, been under the command of [[Supreme Commander (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Supreme Commander]] [[Komm Karsh]]. After attending to damage and casualties, Farlander moved his forces to Kashyyyk from where they could respond to threats against both the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. When Kre'fey returned from Bothawui, he debriefed Farlander and Solo aboard the ''Ralroost''. The admiral was impressed by their initiative, as well as the victory and recommended them both for commendations.<ref name="dw" /> While based at Kashyyyk, Farlander participated in the planning of the [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|raid on Ylesia]], though he was not involved in the battle itself.<ref name="ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>

====Battle of Ebaq====
Later that year, retired New Republic [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] Admiral Ackbar formulated a plan to lure the Yuuzhan Vong [[Warmaster]], [[Tsavong Lah]], into a trap. The Yuuzhan Vong were led to believe that Chief of State [[Cal Omas]] had taken refuge at [[Ebaq 9]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], under the protection of several Jedi. As anticipated, the Yuuzhan Vong saw this as an opportunity to kill both the Chief of State and his Jedi guardians; Lah assembled a fleet, comprising five [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] and prepared for a major assault. While Kre'fey led the majority of his forces in a series of diversionary raids against the enemy, Farlander was given command of a squadron of forty [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and sent straight to Ebaq 9 to begin preparations.<ref name="dw" />

[[File:Keyan_Farlander.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Keyan Farlander]]
Upon exiting hyperspace, Lah ordered [[Battle Group of Yun-Yammka|Yun-Yammka group]] to [[Battle of Ebaq|engage]] Farlander's force directly, with [[Battle Group of Yun-Txiin|Yun-Txiin]] and [[Battle Group of Yun-Q'aah|Yun-Q'aah]] groups moving to flank the New Republic ships and the remaining two groups waiting in reserve. Vastly outnumbered, Farlander appeared to move cautiously at first but, as he approached Yun-Yammka, he ordered a change of formation from an extended line into a compact, pointed blade and opened fire at Yun-Yammka's extended line. The tactic worked, the concentrated fire leaving eight of the largest Yuuzhan Vong ships disabled or dead. Farlander then swung his squadron around to punch through the enemy battle group again before the flanking battle groups could concentrate against him.<ref name="dw" />

The Yuuzhan Vong adjusted their tactics in response to Farlander's maneuver and the New Republic forces seemed about to be overwhelmed by superior numbers when Admiral Kre'fey's forces entered the system. Ackbar's plan was to force Lah to commit his forces before springing the full trap. Consequently Kre'fey's fleet gave the impression of escorting a supply convoy which promptly returned to hyperspace. The new arrivals forced a change of strategy from Lah, who ordered Yun-Txiin to disengage from Farlander's squadron and move to engage Kre'fey along with one of his reserve groups. With a sudden [[Solo Slingshot]], Farlander was able to disengage his forces and approach Yun-Txiin from behind, trapping them between the two Republic squadrons and inflicting heavy damage on the enemy.<ref name="dw" />

In order to prevent Farlander an Kre'fey being overwhelmed, they were soon reinforced by a [[Smugglers' Alliance]] fleet commanded by Han Solo. Lah, assuming that the small, heterogeneous fleet had been summoned by a distress call, dispatched Yun-Q'aah group to engage. Meanwhile, a small Republic force positioned [[Mine/Legends|mines]] along the Yuuzhan Vong's escape vector, placing an [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]] to pull them out of hyperspace into the mines when they tried to flee. Once this was complete, Kre'fey called for the main New Republic Fleet, under the command of General [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]. Realizing that the battle was lost, Lah ordered the majority of his fleet to retreat while leading [[Battle Group of Yun-Yuuzhan|his own battle group]] in a last ditch attack on Ebaq 9 itself, in the hopes of killing as many Jedi as possible.<ref name="dw" />

Farlander, together with the other commanding officers turned their forces towards Ebaq 9 in pursuit, wiping out the remainder of Yun-Yuuzhan. The ten thousand Yuuzhan Vong troops who had landed on the moon, including Tsavong Lah, were killed due to the actions of the Jedi [[Vergere]] and Jaina Solo, while many of the fleeing Yuuzhan Vong ships were destroyed by the Republic mine field.<ref name="dw" /> The battle was a major victory for the New Republic and a turning point in the war.<ref name="NEC" />

====Road to Coruscant====
After the victory at Ebaq 9, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] Omas restructured the New Republic into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" /> Working with its allies, including the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], the Galactic Alliance won a string of victories that convinced Farlander and many other senior commanders that the war would turn into a simple mopping-up operation. However, the Yuuzhan Vong found ways to counter the tactics used by the Alliance and the war dragged on for another year.<ref name="uf" />

In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the Alliance learned that the Yuuzhan Vong were planning a massive [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|assault]] on its provisional capital of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and Farlander was one of several high-ranking officers called to a meeting on Admiral Kre'fey's flagship. The Alliance commanders decided to take advantage of the situation by committing only half of their fleet to the defense of Mon Calamari, while moving the remainder to a staging area near [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] to prepare for their own strike to retake the former Republic capital, Coruscant. Farlander was assigned to this latter group. When Warmaster [[Nas Choka]] engaged Alliance forces near Mon Calamari, the Alliance commanders were surprised by the sudden withdrawal of part of the Yuuzhan Vong fleet along a vector that would lead back to Coruscant. Concerned that they would be caught between Coruscant's defenses and the returning flotilla, Farlander, along with Generals [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and [[Eldo Davip]], contacted Admiral Kre'fey, who was leading the defense of Mon Calamari. Kre'fey instructed them to delay the attack until they could determine what the enemy had planned.<ref name="uf" />

The Yuuzhan Vong ultimately withdrew from Mon Calamari and the Alliance regrouped at Contruum. From there, Farlander was sent to [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] in an [[Battle of Corulag (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attempt to liberate]] the planet and secure a key world close to Coruscant. Upon arriving, the ''Mon Adapyne'' and its starfighters moved to engage the Yuuzhan Vong defenders, assisted by General [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] aboard the [[Elegos A'Kla (Imperial-class)|''Elegos A'Kla'']]. The Yuuzhan Vong ships took up defensive positions around their yammosk and the two generals had the enemy boxed in by the time General Bel Iblis moved in with the [[Harbinger (Mon Calamari Star Cruiser)|''Harbinger'']], catching the Yuuzhan Vong in a crossfire between the Galactic Alliance ships. Once the battle was over, Farlander, Celchu and General Wedge Antilles were instructed to proceed straight to [[Muscave]] in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] to rendezvous with the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]].<ref name="uf" />

====Recapture of Coruscant====
In response to the arrival of the living world [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] in the Coruscant system, the Yuuzhan Vong had amassed a large fleet in the system. The Second Fleet positioned themselves between Coruscant and Zonama Sekot, luring Nas Choka's fleet away from Coruscant and allowing the Alliance to land forces on the former capital. The [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|fighting]] near Muscave soon deteriorated into a brawl, with heavy losses on both sides, but the Second Fleet held out until Admiral Kre'fey arrived with forty ships from the [[First Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|First Fleet]] to relieve them.<ref name="uf" />

Despite the Second Fleet's efforts, Yuuzhan Vong forces had managed to reach Zonama Sekot and had engaged the Jedi, Hapan and Smugglers' Alliance ships defending the world. As the fighting near Zonama Sekot intensified, three Yuuzhan Vong battle groups moved from Muscave to strengthen their forces. Seeing the threat, Farlander and Antilles decided to withdraw elements of the Second Fleet from Muscave in pursuit, acting without the approval of either Kre'fey or Supreme Commander [[Sien Sovv]].<ref name="uf" />

As the battle raged throughout the system, Luke Skywalker led a mission to the surface of Coruscant, confronting and killing Supreme Overlord Shimrra. As news of Shimmra's death spread, Nas Choka realized that the battle was lost and the Yuuzhan Vong surrendered, bringing the war to an end. In the aftermath of the battle, Farlander and Bel Iblis were appointed as Coruscant's occupation commanders by Admiral Sovv and Farlander was among the senior Alliance figures who attended the [[Sekot accords|formal surrender]] of Nas Choka aboard the ''Ralroost''. Continuing his joint service to the Galactic Alliance and the Jedi, Farlander attended a [[Conclave on Zonama Sekot|conclave]] of the Jedi called by Luke Skywalker on Zonama Sekot a few weeks after the liberation of Coruscant to discuss the future of their order.<ref name="uf" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Farlander.svg|thumb|left|200px|Keyan Farlander]]
As a young man, Farlander was a typical resident of a quiet Outer Rim world. He had little interest in galactic politics, considering himself to be a loyal subject of the Empire. All that changed with the death of his parents at the hands of the Empire. His desire for revenge drove him to first the Agamar Resistance and then the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="xw:osg" />

His natural piloting abilities enabled him to quickly enter combat but as he lost more and more friends to the war he lost the youthful enthusiasm and quickly grew in maturity. Through this he relied on his friends, developing a good relationship with his wingmates and getting involved in practical jokes, particularly after [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]] joined the squadron. When he was suspended after the deaths of Tan'tro and Ahsmar, it was the support of Hamo Blastwell and Sam Raider that helped him through.<ref name="xw:osg" />

However, eventually the loss of so many friends caught up with him. The death of Breth Gart left Farlander feeling alone and unsure of himself. It was this that ultimately led him towards the dark side, his desire to prevent more deaths fueling his desire to hurt the Empire. Those who were not up to the fight were unworthy of him. He overcame his internal conflict, with help from Blastwell, but many of his friendships had been damaged.<ref name="xw:osg" />

By the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War, Farlander had developed into a talented military strategist, serving as one of the leading commanders for the New Republic during the war. At the Battle of Ebaq, where his job was essentially to keep the Yuuzhan Vong occupied until the rest of the fleet arrived to spring the trap, he not only achieved this but managed to destroy several Yuuzhan Vong ships in the process. He was also capable of improvising and acting without orders, as demonstrated by his decision to go after Supreme Commander Shimrra's forces at Obroa-skai<ref name="dw" /> and the Second Fleet's withdrawal from Muscave to reinforce Zonama Sekot without authorization from his and General Antilles's superiors.<ref name="uf" />

While taking his duties to the Republic seriously, Farlander did not lose sight of his responsibility to those who served under him, showing concern for his subordinates and a willingness to bend the rules on occasions, such as granting [[Jagged Fel]] permission to visit the off-limits Zonama Sekot to see Jaina Solo in the aftermath of the Liberation of Coruscant.<ref name="uf" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|The Force isn't as I described. You've got to understand this. It's not about powers. It's about knowledge. It's not about controlling. It's about trusting.|Keyan Farlander|<ref name="1BBY" />}}
[[File:Farlander_ROTJ_promo.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Before the Battle of Endor]]
Farlander's Force-sensitivity first manifested itself in his subconscious while he slept. Taking the form of a dream in which he was in a large, glowing sphere, Farlander described hearing two opposite voices and not knowing which he should listen to. As the dreams started to disrupt his sleep, affecting his concentration, Commander Lagrane suggested he seek medical advice. It was while consulting with a doctor that Farlander experienced the Force for the first time, using the Force to persuade the doctor that there was nothing wrong with him.<ref name="xw:osg" />

After the death of Breth Gart, Farlander started to find one of the voices in his dream helped ease the pain. It assured him that he could seize control of his life, and use his power to help others. It was this that led him on a path toward the dark side.<ref name="xw:osg" />

[[File:KeyanFarlander-TCGAR.png|thumb|left|200px|Farlander in the cockpit of a B-wing starfighter]]
Despite his lack of formal training in the use of the Force, Farlander quickly developed an ability to control the minds of others, though he found it difficult to control at times. His behavior caused Lagrane to order him for a psychiatric evaluation by one of the ship's medical droids, the results of which almost led to him being grounded. Only Farlander's use of the mind trick on Commanders Lagrane and S'man convinced them to let him remain active. Farlander even found that he could almost control the mind of enemy pilots, forcing them into his sights.<ref name="xw:osg" />

Farlander also developed other abilities, using Force choke on Ernek Marskan and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Push]] on Sam Raider, before turning his back on the dark side and deciding not to pursue his abilities further.<ref name="xw:osg" /> He did eventually accept formal training at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum, ultimately becoming a Jedi Knight<ref name="CSWE" /> and instructor in his own right.<ref name="wwnjo" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FarlanderBacta.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Keyan Farlander in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] in a non-canon cutscene]]
Keyan Farlander was created for the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] in which his first mission features as a training scenario.<ref name="swxw" /> The story of how Farlander came to join the Rebel Alliance and the events surrounding his first mission was told in ''[[The Farlander Papers]]'', a novella by [[Rusel DeMaria]] which was included with limited edition early copies of the game.<ref name="tfp" /> DeMaria further expanded Farlander's story and established him as the game's player character in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'', released that same year. Farlander can be seen briefly in cutscenes shown if the player's ship is destroyed. If Farlander ejects safely, he is either rescued and shown receiving bacta treatment or captured and tortured by Darth Vader. If the auto ejection system fails, a cutscene depicts Farlander's funeral. The [[After-action report/Legends|after-action reports]] in ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'', which describe how each mission plays out, confirm that none of these events occur.<ref name="xw:osg" /><ref name="swxw" /> Farlander makes an on-screen appearance in a cutscene in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing|''B-Wing'']] expansion pack for ''X-Wing'' ([[1994]]), although only the back of his head is shown and the actor who provided his voice is not credited.<ref name="bw" /> There is an inconsistency in the character's rank between the ''B-Wing'' cut-scene and the story as told in ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide''. In the ''B-Wing'' cut-scene, Luke Skywalker refers to Farlander as a lieutenant, but ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'' established that Farlander was promoted to commander after the Battle of Yavin, before the events of ''B-Wing''.<ref name="xw:osg" /><ref name="bw" />

Although Farlander was mentioned in reference books, including ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'' and an entry in ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', both released in [[1998]],<ref name="EGPM" /><ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|"Farlander, Keyan"}}</ref> the character did not appear again until the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|New Jedi Order]], a series of novels which began in [[2000]]. Farlander was mentioned in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]'' by [[Michael A. Stackpole]]'' and subsequently appeared in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]'' by [[Walter Jon Williams]] and ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'' by [[James Luceno]], along with the short story ''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]'', also by Walter John Williams.<ref name="dw" /><ref name="uf" /><ref name="ylesia" /><ref name="DTI:O">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2001]] [[Star Wars Insider 57|''Star Wars Insider'' 57]] article "[[Who's Who in the New Jedi Order]]" established that Farlander had become a Jedi by the time of the New Jedi Order series, having first been identified as Force-sensitive in ''The Farlander Papers''.<ref name="tfp" /><ref name="wwnjo" /> However, when Walter Jon Williams wrote him into ''Destiny's Way'', he was not aware Farlander was a Jedi and his characterization reflected this, with Farlander ignorant of how the [[Force-meld|Jedi meld]] worked.<ref name="dw" /><ref name="tfn">{{JCFCite|url=posts/9244386|board=Authors and Artists|thread=The Official Walter Jon Williams Discussion Thread|user=[[Walter Jon Williams|Walterjon]]|date=2002-10-22|time=5:36 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160701185720/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-walter-jon-williams-discussion-thread.5816776/page-27#post-9244386}}</ref> In the downloadable e-book of ''Ylesia'', Farlander is referred to as "general", a rank which he also holds in ''Destiny's Way'' and ''The Unifying Force''.<ref name="dw" /><ref name="uf" /> When ''Ylesia'' was reprinted as a bonus included with ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', his rank was changed to "[[Commodore/Legends|commodore]]."<ref name="ylesia" /><ref name="DNI:TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

Farlander was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Insider63">{{InsiderCite|63|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> ''A New Hope'' culminates in the Battle of Yavin, in which Luke Skywalker destroys the Death Star.<ref name="anh" /> In ''X-Wing'', the Battle of Yavin comprises three missions; the first two are preliminary missions which take place while the Death Star plans are being analyzed and the third is the trench run itself. Although in ''X-Wing'' it seems like the player/Farlander destroys the Death Star,<ref name="swxw" /> ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'' established that Farlander was assigned a Y-wing and flew with Gold Squadron, while the player takes the role of Skywalker in the final mission.<ref name="xw:osg" /> Following the Battle of Yavin in ''A New Hope'', a lone Y-wing can be seen fleeing the Death Star's destruction.<ref name="anh" /> The "[[Star Wars Q&A]]" section in [[Star Wars Insider 63|''Star Wars Insider'' 63]] ([[2002]]) identified Farlander as the pilot of this Y-wing, as did the Questions & Answers section on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Insider63" /><ref name="Q&A">{{SWArchive|url=qa/?cat=387&question=1455|text=Star Wars Questions & Answers}}</ref> This was later repeated in the "''[[Ask Lobot]]''" feature in [[Star Wars Insider 125|''Star Wars Insider'' 125]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Insider125" /> In [[April]] [[2014]], [[Lucasfilm]] announced that existing [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] material was no longer considered part of ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] and that all future material would form part of a new continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> In the new canon, the identity of the Y-wing pilot was changed to [[Evaan Verlaine]].<ref name="Leia1">[[Princess Leia 1|''Princess Leia'' 1]]</ref><ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

[[File:Keyan_Farlander_SW_Facebook.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Farlander on ''Home One'']]
The character was also retconned into [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] when his name was given to a previously unidentified B-wing pilot attending the briefing prior to the Battle of Endor. The retcon was revealed in the "''Ask Lobot''" feature in ''Star Wars Insider'' 125 and Leland Chee later identified the specific B-wing pilot on [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook]].<ref name="Insider125" /><ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|author=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2011-08-04|url=photo.php?fbid=10150331528863894&comment_id=5649704&offset=6|nobackup=true}}</ref> Following the decision to identify the B-wing pilot as Farlander,<ref name="Insider125" /> a Farlander action figure was included in a [[2008]] "Evolutions" [[W:c:swmerchandise:Rebel Pilot Legacy Series II (87653)|three-pack]] of Rebel pilots as part of [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]''. Both the figure and box art portray him as a B-wing pilot during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Hasbro" /> A minifigure representing a B-wing pilot flying the Battle of Endor in a [[2013]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set was later identified as Farlander in a display at the [[2014]] [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]].<ref name="LEGO" /><ref name="FBTB" />

An image of Keyan Farlander by [[Keith Carter]] appeared in the ''[[1995 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 3]]'' trading cards, released by [[Topps]] in [[1995]].<ref name="GalaxyS3">{{Topps|set=1995 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 3|cardname=Keith Carter (L10)|link=http://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/82502/cid/6590889?PageIndex=1}}</ref> There is a clear discrepancy between his appearance in the trading card image and the later images of him found in ''The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons'' and ''Who's Who in the New Jedi Order'' which was discussed by Lucasfilm's [[Leland Chee]] in his blog on StarWars.com in [[2007]].<ref name="wwnjo" /><ref name="EGPM" /><ref name="GalaxyS3" /><ref name="Blog-holocron|42">{{Blog|holocron|42|Visual Discrepancies in the EU}}</ref> Farlander's entry in the 2008 reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly names his ship during the Second Battle of Obroa-skai as the ''Adapyne'' instead of the ''Mon Adapyne'' as it appears in ''Destiny's Way''.<ref name="dw" /><ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:Keyan_Farlander_B-Wing_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|Farlander flying a B-wing]]
In the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], Keyan Farlander was added to the game as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in [[W:c:swg:Game Update 20|Game Update 20]]. Imperial players who requested [[W:c:swg:Tier|Tier 7]] [[W:c:swg:Destroy Duty Missions|Duty Missions]] from certain [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] had a chance to battle an [[W:c:swg:Ace Pilot System|elite Rebel pilot]] during the mission's boss stage. One of these pilots could be Keyan Farlander. If the player defeated Farlander, the Rebel was not destroyed. Instead, a message was displayed to the player, indicating that they successfully defeated the pilot. The player then received a [[W:c:swg:Collection|collection]] icon which added up to award a [[W:c:swg:Badges|badge]] if they succeeded in destroying all ten of the elite Rebel pilots. However, elite Rebel pilots could also be found flying in various space battles, which took place in the Naboo, Tatoo, Corellian, Dantooine, and Karthakk systems. Because Farlander only appeared in the space portion of ''Star Wars Galaxies'', originally added with the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] expansion pack, he could normally only be seen inside his respective T-65 X-wing starfighter. However, a comm display could appear during the battle, displaying Farlander's face. In addition, the collection icon depicted Farlander's physical appearance. Although players could choose not to participate in any of the battles or collections connected to Farlander, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
